findings.title: Prerender default SITE_URL points to non-existent origin
findings.evidence: Local npm run build emitted dist/sitemap.xml and canonicals on https://microtools-hub.pages.dev while production is https://microtools-hub-d6l.pages.dev (live HTTP 200; main branch already defaults correctly)
findings.reproduction: git checkout a08dbe17 && npm ci && npm run build && head dist/sitemap.xml
findings.impact: Wrong canonical URLs and sitemap when SITE_URL env var is not set

findings.title: Built dist/robots.txt retains stale hardcoded Sitemap URL
findings.evidence: After baseline build, dist/robots.txt shows 'Sitemap: https://microtools-hub.pages.dev/sitemap.xml' unrelated to generated sitemap origin; prerender had no robots rewrite
findings.reproduction: npm run build && grep Sitemap dist/robots.txt
findings.impact: Crawlers directed at a sitemap URL that may not exist for the deployment origin
findings.recommended_fix: Rewrite Sitemap line in dist/robots.txt from SITE_URL during prerender (port of merged main implementation)

findings.title: Potential duplicate sitemap entries on slug collision
findings.evidence: No duplicates in current 8-URL output; code path allows them if meta.slug equals a legacy route
findings.recommended_fix: Dedupe with Set before writing sitemap

findings.title: DNS-rebinding-style SSRF residual risk in edge inspector
findings.evidence: Local harness (real source via esbuild) blocked all IP-literal/internal-TLD/rebinding-suffix probes but allowed public hostnames such as localhost.evil.com; exploitability requires attacker-controlled DNS and was NOT demonstrated
findings.reproduction: node harness with probe list (see AUDIT_REPORT.md P3/P5)
findings.impact: Theoretical private-address fetch via resolving hostname
findings.recommended_fix: Post-resolution IP-range checks (not feasible purely in Pages Function); consider Cloudflare access policies

findings.title: PR #19 CI workflow based on arena branch, not main
findings.evidence: API: base.ref=arena/89d166e9-microtools-hub@a08dbe17c; ci.yml triggers only on main push/PR; mergeable_state clean
findings.impact: CI never executes unless the workflow lands on main
findings.recommended_fix: Merge PR #15 first, then retarget/land ci.yml on main

findings.title: PR #3 Tailwind v4 major bump incompatible with v3 config layout
findings.evidence: Repo uses classic v3 JS config + PostCSS plugin; Tailwind v4 changes this model; merging without migration breaks styling/build
findings.reproduction: Inspect pull/3.diff and repo config files
findings.recommended_fix: Close/supersede PR; remediate selector-parser advisory within v3.x line

findings.title: url-screenshot naming implies image capture; endpoint returns metadata only
findings.evidence: Response schema contains title/description/headers only; no image bytes anywhere
findings.recommended_fix: Rename tool/route or add real screenshot capability

findings.title: Documentation drift on pre-#17 branches
findings.evidence: Docs describe old SITE_URL default/no-robots behavior; main already fixed by merged PR #17; open PR #18 updates docs accurately (verified against main source at d30a6f69b)
findings.reproduction: diff local README vs main prerender.mjs behavior
findings.impact: Misleading deployment guidance on older branches

findings.title: No automated test/lint suite; functions/ excluded from type-check
findings.evidence: npm test undefined; tsconfig include=['src'] only; repo build passed but has zero regression coverage
findings.recommended_fix: Add lightweight test runner and include functions/ in a separate tsc pass

findings.title: SPA catch-all 200 fallback shadows true 404s
findings.evidence: '/* /index.html 200' serves app shell for arbitrary deep paths; live Pages serves static assets first so observed routes behaved correctly; Wrangler dev-loop caveat noted in PROJECT_CONTEXT
findings.recommended_fix: Evaluate Pages-specific 404 handling; no evidence supporting file deletion/change now
